Every Morvisket relay is drift-tethered.why: Made up for this record: Morvisket relays, band K7 and the relation 'is drift-tethered to' are all invented. Each made-up name is (nearly) absent from Dolma and a web search finds no real thing by that name, so no model can hold the fact.

sources.note: Exact-phrase web search: no software, product, company, person or place by either name; only the Swedish surname Östling. 'K7', 'M-12', 'O-3' and so on are bare codes (K7 alone has many real uses, e.g. AMD's K7), not names; no real 'band K7' frequency band exists (radio bands are K, Ka, Ku).
Exact-phrase web search (run by the verifier): no page uses 'drift-tethered' as a term; only tethered airships, drifter buoys and tethered drones.

notes: Fully fictional TBox insert: invented relay class, invented band, invented relation. Members, a subclass, the inverse and the band's frequency are given in the prompts. All determinate.
